_note: Agent-facing. One entry per repaired link, narrowed gate assertion, and allowlist entry the harvest made. Each entry names the file, a grep-able context string, the old target, what was done, and the stage (2a, 2b, 3, 4, 5) whose rebuild restores or re-arms it; null means the change is permanent. Each stage outline consumes the entries keyed to it. The gate narrowings read arm state from scripts/checks/arm-state.mjs; an arm counts as rebuilt as soon as it holds any page outside the kept set, so extend's entries re-arm at the 2a pilot, not at 2b.
